an_burst_note: Length variation = how much sentence length varies (human prose is usually more varied). These numbers explain the result; they are not part of the verdict.
auth_note: Shares by words. Sentence-level detection is weaker than whole-text detection, so these shares are a lower bound.
b_drop: Drop any number of files here or click to choose (.pdf, .docx, .txt, .md). They are checked one after another and saved to History.
b_folder_note: The folder is checked on this computer (.txt, .md, .docx, .pdf); the number of files per folder is limited.
b_info_done: Folder: {files} files, checked: {done}, errors: {errors}. Results are in History.
banner_new_required: A new version of the app ({ver}) is required to use the latest models.
banner_restart_ready: Update {ver} is downloaded. Restart the app to install it.
banner_restarting: Installing the update; the app will restart by itself…
banner_store_required: To use the new models, update Linda-Pro through Microsoft Store: open Library → Get updates, then restart Linda-Pro. This edition does not use the EXE installer.
banner_too_old: This version of the app is too old for the current models. Please update the app first.
bench_cpu_hint: A graphics card is present but the processor is used: choose Automatic in the list above.
cmp_cell_hint: p_ai {p} · click to open the document
cmp_no_shared: No shared passages of 8 or more words.
cmp_open_a: Open A with shared parts marked
cmp_open_b: Open B with shared parts marked

cmp_sh_line: {count} shared passages · {words} words = {a}% of A and {b}% of B (runs of 8+ identical words, case and punctuation ignored).
cmp_sim_note: Sentence similarity: {pct}% · AI share changed by {delta} · {same} unchanged, {changed} rewritten, {added} added, {removed} removed{equal}.

dev_slow_tip: A graphics card is present but the processor is used. Settings → Run on → Automatic.
diag_ok: linda-diagnostics.zip saved: attach it to your support e-mail. Your checked texts are not included.

err_folder_not_allowed: folder is not allowed by organization policy

err_not_text: The file does not look like text (it contains binary data). Choose .txt, .md, .docx or .pdf.
err_precise_requires_ensemble: Precise mode requires all three models. Use sensitive mode for the selected model.
error_update_path: The model directory links outside the profile. Use a normal directory inside the Linda-Pro profile.
exp_more_t: If you want to rework the flagged sentences yourself, you can copy a ready prompt for an AI assistant.
exp_note: Save the result as a report for your records, a colleague or a student.
exp_prompt_intro: Please rewrite and humanize the following sentences from the document. The Linda-Pro AI detector flagged them as containing characteristic AI artifacts (formulaic transitions, uniform rhythm, predictable academic syntax).
exp_req_1: 1. Rewrite each sentence in a natural, lively, human voice.
exp_req_2: 2. Remove formulaic transition words ("Furthermore", "Moreover", "It is worth noting", "In conclusion", "delves into", "a testament to") and academic padding.
exp_req_3: 3. Vary sentence structure and rhythm (mix short and long sentences, use natural idioms).
exp_req_4: 4. Preserve the original core meaning and context.
f_del_both:
Delete folder “{n}” together with the {c} checks inside it?

OK = delete folder AND its checks.
Cancel = next question.
f_del_only: Delete only the folder “{n}”? Its checks will move to “Unsorted”.
foot_c: Your text is analysed on this computer and is never uploaded. Free for personal non-commercial use; commercial use needs a licence key (
foot_limits_text: English is the main language; Russian and Polish work at moderate quality (thresholds are tuned for English, results are indicative); text length is not limited (above ~3,600 words the 12 windows get wider, so highlighting is coarser). Sentence colours are indicative only: the models were calibrated on ~300-word windows, single sentences are much less reliable. Essays by non-native writers of exam type can get false flags in sensitive mode; precise flags AI only when two independent signals agree. Not better than the best commercial detectors.
foot_never: Never use a verdict as the sole basis for a decision about a person.
gpu_integrated: Only an integrated graphics card was found, so automatic mode uses the processor; to try it, select the graphics card above.
gpu_none: No supported graphics card found: the processor is used.
gpu_tail_discrete: Automatic mode uses it; on first start the models are prepared for the graphics card once (about a minute).
gpu_used_err: The graphics card could not be used ({err}); the processor is used instead.
gran_sentence: Experimental: each sentence is scored on its own, which is much less reliable than a window of text.
gran_smooth: Colours follow sliding windows of about 300 words, so boundaries are accurate to roughly 100 words; a single sentence is not scored on its own.
gran_window: Fast mode: colours show blocks of about 300 words (every sentence in a block gets the score of the block). Choose sliding windows in Settings for finer boundaries.
h_clear_confirm: Delete ALL saved checks, texts and results from this computer?
h_confirm_del: Delete this check and its saved text?
h_confirm_del_sel: Delete {n} selected checks and their saved texts?
h_empty: Nothing here. Every check you run is saved automatically.
h_hist_note: History, texts and results are stored only in the app data folder on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere. Click a title to open the check in the full reader.
h_move_note: Drag a row onto a folder to move it. Folders are only labels on this computer.
lic_privacy: Activation sends only the key and a random device label to the licence server (Polar). Your texts never leave this computer.
lic_state_invalid: The saved key is no longer valid ({status}): it may have been revoked or removed. Enter it again to re-activate.
lic_state_none: No key entered — free personal use.
lic_state_other: This key was activated on another computer. Enter it again to activate it here (on the old computer use Remove key, or free the device in your Polar customer portal).
lic_text: Linda-Pro (the app, the command line tools and the models) is free for personal non-commercial use. Commercial use (paid work, clients, a business, a school or university, a product) needs a licence key; one key covers the app, the command line tools and the models together.
loc_bad: Choose a folder on this computer (not a network share).
loc_long: The folder path is too long.
loc_move: Move the models that are already downloaded
loc_noaccess: No permission to write to this folder.
loc_space: Not enough space in this folder: about 6 GB needed.
loc_unavailable: The models folder is unavailable: {path}. Choose another one.
m_cell_hint: Cell = share of the shorter text that also appears in the other (matching runs of 5 or more words).
m_legend: ≥60% near-copy · 30–60% large overlap · 10–30% some shared passages.
m_out_note: Compare any number of documents at once: overlap matrix and the most similar pairs. Click a cell to open that pair, a row name to open the document.
md_prompt_header: Ready Humanizer Prompt (Copy into Claude / ChatGPT)
paste_fail: Could not read the clipboard: paste the text with Ctrl+V.
pdf_along_note: One bar per sentence (long texts are grouped; height = group maximum).
pdf_disclaimer: A probabilistic estimate, not proof. Never use the verdict as the sole basis for decisions about a person (study, hiring, legal matters).
pdf_how_text: Sentence colours are a hint, not a sentence: models were calibrated on ~300-word windows, single sentences are less reliable. Look at the share and at streaks, not at one sentence.
pdf_local: The text was processed locally on this computer and was never uploaded.
pdf_no_susp: No clearly suspicious sentences — the text looks natural.
pdf_short_ai_share: Share of words that look like AI
pdf_short_limits: The result is a probabilistic estimate by local models, not proof of authorship. Short texts, texts by non-native writers and heavily edited texts can be wrong in either direction. Do not use this summary as the only basis for a decision: compare it with drafts, the time the work took and the author's usual style.
r_tip_pdf: Download PDF (if a PDF library is present)
set_auto_models_note: When a new release brings new models, they are downloaded in the background and replace the old ones (the old ones are removed afterwards).
set_bg_reload: The models are reloading in the background; you can keep working.
set_chg_full: For the full list of changes see:
set_dev_auto_tip: Auto: discrete GPU via DirectML/CUDA (ONNX fp16), else CPU; integrated graphics is skipped.
set_dev_cpu_tip: CPU only, no graphics card; slower but works everywhere.
set_dev_cuda_tip: GPU via DirectML/CUDA (ONNX fp16, ~2.6 GB VRAM); falls back to CPU on failure.
set_dev_note: Usually leave this as is — automatic picks the fast option.
set_gpu_hint: If the wrong card is used, try another one.
set_preload: Load the models when the app starts
set_preload_note: The models are put into memory in the background right after start, while updates are checked, so the first analysis is fast.
set_preload_warn: Warning: with this off, the first analysis will take noticeably longer (roughly 5–15 s on a fast CPU, more on an older one), because the models are loaded at that moment. Later analyses are fast.
set_sent_auto: Automatic: sentences and context; anchor sentences for long texts (recommended)
set_sent_smooth: Sliding windows of ~300 words: accurate boundaries, a few seconds more on a CPU
set_upd_avail: An update is available (see the banner on top).
setup_text: First start: the detector models ({size}) are downloaded once and stay on this computer. Afterwards the app works fully offline.
st_feats: Structure features ({n} outside the human range)
st_map: Document map: one column per paragraph (height = length), cells = sentences coloured by AI label.
st_not_score: Structure is shown for reference only and does not affect the verdict: in our tests, structural patterns alone could not reliably tell human and AI text apart across different kinds of writing, so they are not used in scoring.
st_ref_note: Sentence-level AI probability: typical human sentences, typical AI sentences (reference sets, {a} + {b} sentences) and the sentences of this text. White line = median.
sv_ai_a: This is not proof. Ask the author how they wrote it and ask to see drafts.
sv_ai_t: The text was most likely written by AI
sv_esl: Texts by people writing in a non-native language are sometimes mistaken for AI.
sv_hum_a: No clear signs of AI were found. The detector can still be wrong, especially on short texts.
sv_hum_t: The text was most likely written by a person
sv_lang: The language of the text does not look supported (Russian, Polish, English): the estimate is unreliable.
sv_mixed: The text mixes languages: the estimate is less reliable.
sv_short: The text is short ({n} words): the estimate is less reliable.
sv_symbols: The text has many numbers, code or tables: the estimate is less reliable.
sv_uk: This looks like Ukrainian: the program checks Russian, Polish and English, so the estimate is unreliable.
sv_unc_a: Part of the text looks AI-written. Look at the highlighted sentences and compare with the author's style.
tip_pct: How sure the program is of its conclusion. It is not proof of authorship.
tip_precise: Wrongly suspects people less often but misses more AI texts. For schools and universities.
tip_score: Combined score of the three models: the higher, the more the text looks AI-written.
tip_sensitive: Catches more AI-written texts but more often wrongly suspects people. For personal use.
